next_steps: Contract: any of the 71 markets from registry 0xD6E9D27C75Afd88ad24Cd5EdccdC76fd2fc3A751 getAllPairAddresses() (FraxlendPair V1, verified source src/contracts/FraxlendPairCore.sol; liquidate(uint128 _sharesToLiquidate, uint256 _deadline, address _borrower), modifiers whenNotPaused + nonReentrant + approvedLender, lenderWhitelistActive()=false measured). 7-day count 19 (2.7/day) on 4 pairs; gross 4.3-494 USD per call at today's prices (10% bonus on the repaid debt), gas 0.09-72.61 USD (median 0.75). Others do take it within the block-adjacent window and bid gas (effective gas price 0.126-100.14 gwei on the same pair within 24 h), so the sizeable positions are contested, but the small ones (10 captures of 4.3-5.6 USD gross at 0.2-1.0 USD gas) go unbid: a poll-catchable pond, not a pure same-block race. Pond capacity: 5.647M USD borrow book across 71 pairs, all FRAX-asset; 13 pairs over 1k USD; liquidatability on the tiny pairs is debt-accrual driven (no live collateral feed on some), so positions stay liquidatable until taken (attempts:401). Caveat for a builder: gross is collateral-minus-debt, so it is a 10% collateral position the executor must sell to FRAX/USDC in the same tx; the dust captures do not cover an ethereum round trip, so a bot only earns on the 100+ USD captures (~3 in the last 7 days).
